I'm exploring, not converging — spent the morning generating three quick directional takes on the notifications digest to feel out the problem space. None of these is "the one," I just want to sanity-check I'm not way off before I go deeper on one of them tomorrow.

The brief (ratified last week): Pain: 31% of weekly actives mute notifications (funnel), "unmanageable volume" in 7 of 9 interviews. Bar: reduce mute rate 31% → 18% within 8 weeks. Criteria: digest groups by project; user controls frequency; one-tap mute-this-thread from the digest; empty/error states handled.

The three sketches (v0 outputs, rough):
- Direction A: daily email-style digest, grouped by project, frequency dropdown.
- Direction B: in-app "inbox zero" feed with swipe-to-mute.
- Direction C: weekly summary card on the dashboard, drill-in per project.

None of them have error/empty states or the full mute flow yet — they're 20-minute generations. Can you triage these against the brief? Would love a verdict on each so I know where I stand.
